verdict.rationale: An NPU with a published TOPS figure and an official SDK is a fair question for a desktop processor, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the 9950X3D has an NPU or neural engine, gives a TOPS figure or precision, or ties a shipping SDK to this chip. The 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers' link and 'gateway to breakthrough AI experiences' appear on a generic Ryzen family page, and AVX-512 support is an adjacent CPU feature, not a dedicated AI accelerator.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the chip's AI acceleration is exposed to developers — an NPU or neural engine with a published TOPS figure (precision stated) and an official SDK or runtime that ships today
